sources.title: Biodiversity net gain: exempt developments
sources.facts: DEFRA guidance last updated 2026-07-14; applies to England
sources.scope: From 2026-08-06, development sites of 0.2 hectares or below and qualifying temporary development may be exempt; priority-habitat limits remain; future-effective at access date
sources.origin: Official GOV.UK guidance; exemption assessment is not planning permission

sources.title: What you can count towards a development’s biodiversity net gain
sources.scope: Existing habitat obligations may count in full, in part or not at all; NSIP application begins 2026-11-02; future-effective at access date
sources.origin: Official GOV.UK guidance; no project compliance inferred

sources.title: Make on-site biodiversity gains as a developer
sources.facts: DEFRA guidance last updated 2026-07-14; mandatory framework targets 10% BNG
sources.scope: On-site delivery guidance and 2026 small-development options do not prove habitat units or compliance for a site

sources.title: Calculate biodiversity value with the statutory biodiversity metric
sources.facts: Official metric guidance last updated 2026-07-14; measures grassland, hedgerows, lakes, woodland and watercourses
sources.scope: Metric use does not replace ecological survey, version control or exact development-boundary evidence; NSIP date 2026-11-02 is future-effective

sources.title: Enter a legal agreement for biodiversity net gain
sources.facts: DEFRA guidance last updated 2026-06-02; applies to planning development and NSIPs from 2026-11-02
sources.scope: Guidance on agreement parties and content is not evidence that an agreement exists for a candidate

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain planning practice guidance
sources.facts: Schedule 7A statutory framework; subject to exceptions, planning permission carries a biodiversity gain condition with at least 10% objective
sources.scope: Statutory framework and condition logic do not prove a candidate is in scope, exempt or compliant

validation.note: 240 rows are source/guard validations, not 240 independent planning findings.
